findings.failure_path: Candidate transcripts are appended as newline-delimited paths without canonicalization or deduplication. With `--logs root,root/sub` (or the same root twice), files under the overlap appear twice, so total sessions, per-file counts, and potentially shares are inflated while `reference_access_census_ok` still prints. A filename containing a newline is also split into invalid candidates.
findings.smallest_fix: Build one NUL-delimited candidate inventory, canonicalize and deduplicate transcript identities before counting, and add overlapping-root, repeated-root, symlink-root, and newline-containing filename regressions.

findings.failure_path: Under root, the unreadable-input leg explicitly skips and the suite still prints its success token, so the withholding behavior can regress undetected. The default-root leg sets HOME rather than testing an unset HOME, and the large-path fixture uses `seq`, which is absent from stock macOS despite the claimed BSD/macOS compatibility.
findings.smallest_fix: Use a deterministic command shim to force the transcript-read error, add an `env -u HOME` case, and generate fixture names with a bash loop rather than `seq`.

findings.failure_path: “The pairing is not optional in a retro” requires every retro to produce a sustain side, but the entrypoint permits stable-success treatment only with mechanism, non-luck evidence, reuse conditions, firing point, and owner. A failure-only incident with no independently supported success can therefore either violate this new rule or fabricate a stable-success row contrary to classification.
findings.smallest_fix: Require a sustain row only when stable-success evidence meets the entry bar; otherwise require an explicit `none` or `unstable/insufficient evidence` disposition. Limit the Army AAR statement to that source's context rather than universalizing it to every retro.

findings.smallest_fix: Include bounded excerpts or diffs of the routing runner, merge-side binder, and governing classification reference, plus the relevant primary-source passages or contract tests that prove the new documentation matches them.

challenge_focus: Unprimed adversarial challenge of the fix batch. (1) reference-access-census.sh as a counting instrument: overlapping or symlinked --logs roots, a transcript listed twice, a skill name that is a prefix of another package name, paths containing spaces or newlines, a --days window edge at mtime rounding, and any path where counts or shares are wrong while the ok token still prints. (2) The three new test legs: can any pass while the property it names is broken (shim ordering on PATH, chmod under root, missing-root leg when HOME is unset), and is any leg platform-dependent (BSD vs GNU userland). (3) incident-postmortem-extraction.md §Success reviews: any obligation that contradicts the classification rule in SKILL.md or source-to-skill-extraction.md, and any quoted clause that over-reads Hollnagel, Levitt & March, Ellis & Davidi, or TC 25-20. (4) eval-routing.md trigger-eval bullet and quickstart §3e exclusion rule: any statement that contradicts the runner or binder code as it exists.
